        return r

    def polar_to_cartesian(r, phi):
        x = r * math.cos(phi)
        y = r * math.sin(phi)
        return x, y

    def is_valid_release(phi):
        r = b * phi
        x, y = polar_to_cartesian(r, phi)
        # Check if the point is on the spiral and moving towards the target
        # Calculate the angle between the line from the origin to the release point
        # and the line from the release point to the target
        angle_to_target = math.atan2(ty - y, tx - x)
        angle_from_origin = phi
        # The avatar should move towards the target
        return angle_to_target > angle_from_origin

    def is_intersecting_spiral(phi1, phi2):
        # Check if the line segment between two points on the spiral intersects with the spiral
        r1 = b * phi1
        r2 = b * phi2
        x1, y1 = polar_to_cartesian(r1, phi1)
        x2, y2 = polar_to_cartesian(r2, phi2)
